name: Bhutan (Indian Standards with Bhutan's zoning)
edition: Bhutan Building Rules with IS 1893 / IS 875
description: A thin pack for Bhutan (alpha 9 track C23): Bhutan designs to the Indian Standards, so it extends the built-in pack is-codes (IS 875 loads, IS 1893 (Part 1):2016 seismic, IS 456 concrete, IS 800 steel and the rest) and sets only Bhutan's towns: the seismic zone of each (western Bhutan zone IV, central, eastern and south-eastern Bhutan zone V, Z = 0.24 / 0.36 of IS 1893 Table 3) and the basic wind speed Vb of IS 875 (Part 3):2015 read at the adjoining Indian regions (47 or 50 m/s). Mountain sites need the topography factor k3 (Project Settings > Wind > Topography, IS 875 (Part 3) Annex C). Every value is listed in VERIFY.md: the zone and Vb of every town are SAEngine readings, to be checked against the zoning Bhutan's Department of Engineering Services applies before design.
